title: The Illusion of Power Capping in LLM Decode: A Phase-Aware Energy Characterisation Across Attention Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2605.11999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Power capping is a common GPU energy lever in LLM serving, and it appears to work: the cap is set, the GPU reports drawing less than it, and the energy budget is met. We show the cap does little for the phase that dominates LLM serving: autoregressive decode. Across four attention paradigms (GQA, MLA, Gated DeltaNet, and Mamba2) on an NVIDIA H200 under vLLM eager execution, decode kernels wait on HBM and the GPU idles between kernel launches, so decode draws less than half of the GPU's 700W rating and throughput stays within a few percent under every cap we set. The cap engages only when a large batch runs a long generation. Locking the SM clock instead lowers power without slowing memory-bound decode and recovers up to 32% of decode energy at minimal throughput loss. We identify three architecture-dependent frequency-scaling classes and find that, once prefill is measured without prefix caching, the recurrent architectures pay

translated_title: 大语言模型解码阶段功率上限的错觉：跨注意力架构的相位感知能耗特征分析
translated_abstract: 功率上限是LLM服务中常用的GPU能耗调节手段，且看似有效：设置了上限，GPU报告的功耗低于该上限，能耗预算得以满足。我们证明该上限对主导LLM服务的阶段——自回归解码——几乎没有作用。在NVIDIA H200上使用vLLM eager执行模式，跨四种注意力范式（GQA、MLA、Gated DeltaNet和Mamba2），解码内核等待HBM内存且GPU在内核启动之间处于空闲状态，因此解码功耗不到GPU额定700W的一半，并且在我们设置的所有功率上限下吞吐量变化都仅在几个百分点以内。功率上限仅在大批量运行长时间生成时才会生效。相反，锁定SM时钟可以在不减慢内存受限解码的情况下降低功耗，以最小的吞吐量损失回收多达32%的解码能耗。我们识别出三种依赖于架构的频率缩放类别，并发现，一旦在不使用前缀缓存的情况下测量prefill阶段，循环架构需要支付……
tldr: 该研究发现GPU功率上限对LLM自回归解码阶段几乎无效（解码功耗本就不到额定功率的一半），而锁定SM时钟频率才是更有效的节能手段，能以极小的吞吐量损失回收多达32%的解码能耗。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that GPU power capping is largely ineffective for LLM autoregressive decode (which draws less than half the rated power), and that locking the SM clock instead recovers up to 32% of decode energy with minimal throughput loss.
